ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of $4.44 to the rider for the un-exempted detour on the Yio Chu Kang detour segment (RD-2 metered mileage refund: 3.15 km × $1.4100/km), and warn the driver that RD-1 breached (no mutual agreement was reached before leaving the shortest route, and the GPS re-route is not a reasonable cause under RD-4).

segment_findings.reason: Un-exempted off-route out-and-back excursion (~09:32–09:39) off the PIE via Yio Chu Kang Rd, ~3.16 km extra (meter 24.71 km vs quoted 21.553 km); no passenger-named stop or route change in chat (RD-3(a) N/A), no chat agreement before leaving the route (RD-5 fails), no incident and only band-4 (not band 1–2) speed bands on the replaced PIE segment (RD-4(a)/(b) fail). RD-1 breached; refund under RD-2 metered branch.

rejected_claims.reason: RD-2 metered branch refunds only the un-exempted detour's extra mileage units, not the whole fare or the extra time units.
RD-4 requires traffic-incident corroboration on the replaced optimal-route segment; traffic.incidents is empty and the only speed bands are band 4, so no reasonable cause is established.
